JEDP is a Java Interface to access abas ERP and its database using EDP.

JEDP is downward compatible to older versions of abas ERP. However it can always be used in its latest version. If you need a feature or bug fix which is contained in the latest version, you can simply download it from the abas homepage.

Many methods have a property "Since:" which says in which version of abas ERP the method is supported by the server. However, there won't be checked in this API whether the server really supports the corresponding EDP feature. On an invalid call of a methode the server will reject the request and an appropriate exception will be thrown. Methods without version information in general can be used with any version of abas ERP.
